summary: Quote on two NSE equities: after one is unsubscribed (a PUT) the other keeps streaming, and an event for the one let go reaches nobody.

notes: Audit appendix inherited item 3: this web adapter disconnects the whole socket after any unsubscribe (self.disconnect() in unsubscribe), so every other symbol stops; the desktop removes only the instrument let go.

deviations.reason: The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

This web adapter disconnects the whole socket after any unsubscribe (self.disconnect() in unsubscribe), so every other symbol stops streaming; the desktop removes only the instrument let go (audit appendix, inherited item 3).
